editorial:
Imagine you are a low-life criminal who suddenly gets kidnapped by the KGB. That is exactly what happens to Franco and Ciccio, two goofy guys who just happen to look identical to a pair of missing cosmonauts. To save face, the Russian government decides to fake a heroic return by launching these two crooks in a rocket and crashing them right in front of a cheering crowd. The whole thing is a wild, silly ride that feels like a big prank. You will love the chaos as these two clueless guys try to act like brave space heroes while having no idea what is going on.

The comedy comes from the awkward moments, especially when they manage to fool the astronauts' own wives. While the special effects are very old-school, that actually adds to the charm. The pacing is quick, and the acting is intentionally over-the-top. If you enjoy campy humor and weird plots, you should definitely check this out. It is a great pick for a lazy Sunday. You can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, or if you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when the real spacecraft finally lands back on Earth perfectly fine. Now the government has two sets of the same men! To fix the mess, a funny swap happens. Franco and Ciccio decide they actually like living in Russia, so they stay behind. Meanwhile, the real astronauts are tired of the pressure and decide to move to Italy for a quiet life. Everyone gets what they want in a weird, happy twist.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school comedy and absurd stories.
